rows.Risk Description: Lack of clear accountability for cheque book management.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure clear accountability for cheque book management.
rows.Control Activity: Designated persons at branches/HO will prepare a manual request on company letterhead, obtain signatures of the authorized signatories & hand it over to the bank.

rows.Risk Description: Unauthorized access to cheque books.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure unauthorized access to cheque books is prevented.
rows.Control Activity: Branches need to keep the cheque books in safe under lock & key; Branch cashiers will select the running cheque number, while issuing it to their customers/vendors for making the payment entries in ERP;

rows.Risk Description: Lack of segregation of duties.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure segregation of duties for cheque book management is maintained.
rows.Control Activity: Designated persons at branches/HO will prepare a manual request on company letterhead, obtain signatures of the authorized signatories & hand it over to the bank;

rows.Risk Description: Risk of unauthorized use or misuse of cheque books.
rows.Control Objective: Reduce the risk of unauthorized use or misuse of cheque books.
rows.Control Activity: Branches need to keep the cheque books in safe under lock & key; Branch cashiers will select the running cheque number, while issuing it to their customers/vendors for making the payment entries in ERP;

rows.Risk Description: Risk of discrepancies between physical cheques and ERP records.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure accurate reconciliation of physical cheques with ERP records.
rows.Control Activity: Everyday evening, before doing the End of Day (EOD) process in ERP, branch cashiers will cross tally available physical cheques with ERP cheque stock report;

rows.Risk Description: Lack of clear communication regarding cheque book management.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure clear communication regarding cheque book management is maintained.
rows.Control Activity: Designated persons at branches/HO will prepare a manual request on company letterhead, obtain signatures of the authorized signatories & hand it over to the bank;

rows.Risk Description: Lack of regular monitoring of cheque book management.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure regular monitoring of cheque book management is conducted.
rows.Control Activity: Branches need to keep the cheque books in safe under lock & key; Branch cashiers will select the running cheque number, while issuing it to their customers/vendors for making the payment entries in ERP;

rows.Risk Description: Lack of clear authorization limits for payments.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all payments are within authorized limits.
rows.Control Activity: Branch managers must approve payment requests before issuance.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Insufficient segregation of duties in payment processing.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure separation between authorization and execution of payments.
rows.Control Activity: Branch cashiers prepare cheques, while branch managers approve them.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate control over the use of bank accounts.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all payments are made through authorized bank accounts.
rows.Control Activity: Branches/HO operate with dual control signatories on each bank account.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Failure to identify and analyze potential fraud risks.
rows.Control Objective: Identify and mitigate potential fraudulent activities in payment processing.
rows.Control Activity: Branch managers review purchase documents before approving payments.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate control over the reconciliation of payment transactions.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure accurate and timely reconciliation of trading payments.
rows.Control Activity: Branch cashiers cross-tally available physical cheques with ERP cheque stock report daily.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of timely communication between branches and HO regarding payment transactions.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure timely communication for accurate reconciliation.
rows.Control Activity: Branches notify HO Finance team about cash receipts not updated in sales transactions.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate monitoring of payment transactions for compliance.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all payments comply with regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
rows.Control Activity: Branch managers cross-verify purchase details before approving payments.
rows.Financial Statement Assertion: Accurate recording of trading expenses and advances.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of clear commitment to integrity in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all branches and head office personnel adhere to ethical standards during the reconciliation process.
rows.Control Activity: Establish a code of conduct for employees involved in reconciliations, including regular training sessions on ethical practices.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate oversight by the board on bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that the board is informed of any discrepancies or issues in the reconciliation process.
rows.Control Activity: Board members should review periodic reports on reconciliations and take corrective actions if necessary.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate structure, authority, or responsibility for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure clear roles and responsibilities are defined within the finance department for reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Establish a dedicated team responsible for reconciling accounts with banks and ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of commitment to competence in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all personnel involved in reconciliations have the necessary knowledge, skills, and training.
rows.Control Activity: Provide regular training sessions for employees on bank reconciliation procedures and best practices.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of accountability for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure all personnel involved in reconciliations are held accountable for their actions.
rows.Control Activity: Implement a system where discrepancies found during reconciliations must be reported and investigated by senior management.

rows.Risk Description: Failure to specify suitable objectives for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure the reconciliation process aligns with business goals and financial reporting requirements.
rows.Control Activity: Define clear, measurable objectives for the reconciliation process that include timeliness, accuracy, and completeness of reconciliations.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate analysis of risks associated with bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Identify potential risks in the reconciliation process and assess their likelihood and impact.
rows.Control Activity: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential issues such as errors, fraud, or discrepancies that could arise during reconciliations.

rows.Risk Description: Insufficient assessment of fraud risk in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that the process includes measures to prevent and detect fraudulent activities during reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Implement controls such as dual authorization for significant transactions, regular audits by external auditors, and training on recognizing signs of fraud.

rows.Risk Description: Failure to identify significant changes in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that the process is adaptable to any significant changes, such as new regulations or technological advancements.
rows.Control Activity: Conduct regular reviews of the reconciliation process and make necessary adjustments based on feedback from users and auditors.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of selection or development of control activities for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that the process includes appropriate controls to verify the accuracy and completeness of reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Develop a detailed checklist of tasks required for each step in the reconciliation process, including cross-tallying physical cheques with ERP reports.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate general controls over technology for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that all technology used in the reconciliation process is secure and controlled.
rows.Control Activity: Implement strong access controls on ERP systems, ensuring only authorized personnel can perform reconciliations.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate deployment of policies and procedures for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that all personnel involved in reconciliations are aware of the relevant policies and procedures.
rows.Control Activity: Regularly update and distribute the bank reconciliation policy to all relevant employees, including training sessions on key aspects of the process.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate use of relevant information in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that all necessary data is available for accurate reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Regularly review the adequacy of data sources used in reconciliations and ensure they are up-to-date and reliable.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate internal communication regarding bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that all personnel involved in reconciliations are aware of their roles, responsibilities, and the importance of accurate reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Regularly communicate updates to the reconciliation process through departmental meetings and emails.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate external communication regarding bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that all stakeholders, including auditors and regulatory bodies, are informed of the status and findings of reconciliations.
rows.Control Activity: Regularly share reconciliation results with auditors and regulatory bodies as required by law or internal policy.

rows.Risk Description: Lack of ongoing or separate evaluations for bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that the process is regularly evaluated to identify and address any issues.
rows.Control Activity: Conduct regular audits by external auditors to evaluate the effectiveness of reconciliations.

rows.Risk Description: Inadequate evaluation of deficiencies in bank reconciliation processes.
rows.Control Objective: Ensure that any identified deficiencies are evaluated to determine their impact on financial statements and corrective actions are taken.
rows.Control Activity: Implement a system where discrepancies found during reconciliations must be reported, investigated by senior management, and documented for future reference.
